title: HierSVA: A Data Synthesis Pipeline, Dataset, and Benchmark for LLM-Driven Hierarchical Hardware Formal Verification
abstract: arXiv:2606.13706v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present HierSVA, an integrated suite that combines a pipeline, dataset, and benchmark for LLM-driven hierarchical hardware formal verification. HierSVA-SP pairs an RTL preprocessing toolchain with an LLM-in-the-loop formal verification flow to produce reference SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) on hierarchical RTL. Applying it to BaseJump STL yields HierSVA-DS, a dataset of 342 modules, with hierarchy metadata and depths 0--9, accompanied by a deep subset of 28 module-bug pairs with natural-language specifications and bug variants. HierSVA-B decomposes assertion quality into six metric axes: syntax correctness, assertion proof success rate, vacuity, specification faithfulness, mutation coverage, and formal core coverage. Applying HierSVA-B to twelve recent LLMs reveals three findings. translated_title: HierSVA：面向LLM驱动的分层硬件形式验证的数据合成流水线、数据集与基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了HierSVA，这是一个将流水线、数据集和基准测试融为一体的综合套件，用于LLM驱动的分层硬件形式验证。HierSVA-SP将RTL预处理工具链与LLM在环的形式验证流程相结合，以在分层RTL上生成参考SystemVerilog断言（SVA）。将其应用于BaseJump STL后得到HierSVA-DS，这是一个包含342个模块的数据集，带有层次元信息和0至9的层次深度，并附带一个包含28个模块-缺陷对的深层子集，配有自然语言规格说明与缺陷变体。HierSVA-B将断言质量分解为六个度量维度：语法正确性、断言证明成功率、空洞性、规格忠实度、变异覆盖率和形式核心覆盖率。将HierSVA-B应用于十二个近期LLM揭示了三个发现。首先，模块级编译率为67.1%；在可评估运行中生成的断言里，82.1%被证明非空洞有效，但相应的a……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: HierSVA提出了首个面向LLM驱动分层硬件形式验证的集成套件，涵盖数据合成流水线、包含342个模块的分层RTL数据集以及六维度断言质量评估基准，对十二个LLM的评估揭示了编译率、非空洞证明率与规格忠实度等方面的关键发现。
en_tdlr: HierSVA introduces an integrated pipeline-dataset-benchmark suite for LLM-driven hierarchical hardware formal verification, featuring a 342-module hierarchical RTL dataset and a six-axis assertion-quality benchmark, with evaluation of twelve LLMs revealing key findings on compile rates, non-vacuous proof success, and specification faithfulness.
